entries.title: 嵌套 JSON：合并、差异和叶子路径
entries.questionHtml: 给定两个嵌套结构的JSON，实现合并函数：相同key递归合并，仅在一个字典中的key直接保留，列表拼接。如果Key冲突且类型不同怎么办？如果嵌套深度超过1万层怎么办？
entries.analysisHtml: 先说清合并、冲突和差异的规则，再用显式栈处理深层结构。输出正确之外，还要保证输入不被修改。
entries.answerHtml:
嵌套 JSON：合并、差异与叶子路径

结论

嵌套JSON的合并、结构差异与叶子路径是三个相关操作，都可以把待处理任务放入显式栈。这样深度超过一万时不会消耗一万层Java调用栈，但仍会消耗堆空间和输出空间。先约定冲突规则，再写代码。

题目约定

这里分两种题目约定：普通合并要求字典递归合并、单边key保留、列表拼接；rich模式另要求数值相加、字符串拼接、布尔或、其他覆盖。普通题没有定义标量冲突，本实现明确选择右侧覆盖，面试时需先说明这个假设。两种模式都不修改输入，独有子树也深拷贝。字典同key值为null与key缺失不同，用独立ABSENT哨兵区分。

支持的输入

JSON表示限定为null、String、Boolean、有限Number、Map的字符串key及List。Number转换成BigDecimal，十进制0.1+0.2得到精确0.3；如果调用者最初传入的double已经有舍入误差，不能声称恢复原始精度。拒绝非有限数和非JSON对象。合法JSON必须有限无环；实现给展开节点预算，循环引用最终触发预算拒绝，不把共享内存对象图默认为合法JSON。

合并与正确性

每个Work保存待合并的两个值及输出槽。遇两字典，先创建独立目标字典，对键并集逐个入栈；遇两列表，创建结果列表并按原顺序深拷贝两侧元素；标量按合同处理。任务创建时先给父容器分配结果对象，子任务只写自己的槽，所以输出结构完整且所有可变容器都是新建。反向弹栈不改变预先固定的列表下标和字典键遇见顺序。

类型冲突与深度

一侧字典另一侧列表、或容器与标量冲突时采用右侧整体替换并深拷贝。若业务要报错、保留左侧或收集冲突列表，应改变这一分支；不要在类型不同时继续强转字典。每个嵌套层对应显式Work，不做递归调用，12000层单链嵌套测试已通过。预算约束处理任务量，不替代网络输入字节上限、容器大小上限和进程内存预算。

叶子路径

leaves按显式DFS输出JSON Pointer风格路径：key中的~写~0，/写~1，数组用下标；标量根路径为空字符串。这里把空字典/空列表也作为叶子，保留其存在；如果业务只算标量叶子，必须显式改合同。路径用链式段记录，到输出时才拼接，避免每深入一层复制完整路径。输出次序若有要求应另定义，当前字典遍历为栈顺序。

递归diff的明确范围

diff按相同key和相同数组下标递归比较；缺失键标add/remove，标量或类型变化标replace。数值按BigDecimal数值比较，1和1.0视为相等。数组按下标比较，不做LCS，不承诺最小编辑脚本，也不识别移动。返回的是差异报告，数组下标对应原输入；不能把多个remove按升序直接执行在不断变短的数组上。若要可应用的JSON Patch，必须另规定并验证执行顺序。

复杂度与边界

设展开后的节点总数N，合并通常O(N)节点工作和O(N)新输出，另计字符串拼接和大数位成本；任务栈最坏O(N)，深链O(深度)。叶路径与diff另计输出路径文本总长度L，时间不能漏掉O(L)。diff对新增/替换子树深拷贝，输出成本计入N；没有把“非递归”误称常数空间。空对象、空列表、null、异类型冲突、数组拼接、需要转义的key、巨大深度与非法循环都有明确行为。

例子

左 {x:0.1,list:[1,2],flag:false,s:"a"} 与右 {x:0.2,list:[3],flag:true,s:"b"}：rich模式返回x=0.3、list=[1,2,3]、flag=true、s="ab"；普通模式标量分别取右侧。输入list仍只有[1,2]。差异 {"a/b":1}→{"a/b":3} 的路径是/a~1b，不是/a/b。

完整 Java 与自测

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.math.*;
/** JSON values: null, Boolean, String, finite Number, Map<String,Object>, List<Object>. */
public class JsonOperations {
    private static final Object ABSENT=new Object();
    private record Work(Object a,Object b,Consumer<Object> put){}
    private static BigDecimal number(Number n){
        if(n instanceof BigDecimal b)return b;if(n instanceof BigInteger b)return new BigDecimal(b);
        if(n instanceof Byte||n instanceof Short||n instanceof Integer||n instanceof Long)return BigDecimal.valueOf(n.longValue());
        if(n instanceof Double||n instanceof Float){double d=n.doubleValue();if(!Double.isFinite(d))throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonfinite");return new BigDecimal(n.toString());}
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("number type");
    }
    private static Object scalar(Object x){if(x==null||x instanceof String||x instanceof Boolean)return x;if(x instanceof Number n)return number(n);throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON value required");}
    private static Map<String,Object> object(Object x){
        Map<?,?> raw=(Map<?,?>)x;Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(var e:raw.entrySet()){if(!(e.getKey() instanceof String key))throw new IllegalArgumentException("string key");out.put(key,e.getValue());}return out;
    }
    /** Rich mode: numeric sum/string concat/boolean OR. Otherwise scalar conflicts choose right.
     * Maps merge recursively; lists concatenate. Type conflicts choose right. Inputs unchanged.
     * Finite acyclic JSON required; budget bounds expanded work and rejects cycles eventually. */
    public static Object merge(Object left,Object right,boolean rich,int budget){
        if(budget<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("budget");Object[] result=new Object[1];ArrayDeque<Work> todo=new ArrayDeque<>();todo.push(new Work(left,right,x->result[0]=x));int visits=0;
        while(!todo.isEmpty()){
            if(++visits>budget)throw new IllegalArgumentException("expanded node budget exceeded");Work w=todo.pop();Object a=w.a,b=w.b;
            if(a instanceof Map&&b instanceof Map){Map<String,Object> aa=object(a),bb=object(b),out=new LinkedHashMap<>();w.put.accept(out);
                LinkedHashSet<String> keys=new LinkedHashSet<>(aa.keySet());keys.addAll(bb.keySet());
                for(String k:keys){out.put(k,null);todo.push(new Work(aa.containsKey(k)?aa.get(k):ABSENT,bb.containsKey(k)?bb.get(k):ABSENT,x->out.put(k,x)));}
            }else if(a instanceof List<?> aa&&b instanceof List<?> bb){
                List<Object> out=new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(Math.addExact(aa.size(),bb.size()),null));w.put.accept(out);
                for(int i=0;i<out.size();i++){final int j=i;Object v=i<aa.size()?aa.get(i):bb.get(i-aa.size());todo.push(new Work(ABSENT,v,x->out.set(j,x)));}
            }else if(a!=ABSENT&&b!=ABSENT&&rich&&a instanceof Number an&&b instanceof Number bn){w.put.accept(number(an).add(number(bn)));}
            else if(a!=ABSENT&&b!=ABSENT&&rich&&a instanceof String as&&b instanceof String bs){w.put.accept(as+bs);}
            else if(a!=ABSENT&&b!=ABSENT&&rich&&a instanceof Boolean ab&&b instanceof Boolean bb){w.put.accept(ab||bb);}
            else{
                Object v=b==ABSENT?a:b;
                if(v instanceof Map){Map<String,Object> src=object(v),out=new LinkedHashMap<>();w.put.accept(out);for(var e:src.entrySet()){String k=e.getKey();out.put(k,null);todo.push(new Work(ABSENT,e.getValue(),x->out.put(k,x)));}}
                else if(v instanceof List<?> src){List<Object> out=new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(src.size(),null));w.put.accept(out);for(int i=0;i<src.size();i++){final int j=i;todo.push(new Work(ABSENT,src.get(i),x->out.set(j,x)));}}
                else w.put.accept(scalar(v));
            }
        }return result[0];
    }
    private record Path(Path parent,String segment){}
    private static String pointer(Path p){ArrayDeque<String> parts=new ArrayDeque<>();for(;p!=null;p=p.parent)parts.push(p.segment.replace("~","~0").replace("/","~1"));StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();while(!parts.isEmpty())b.append('/').append(parts.pop());return b.toString();}
    private record Visit(Object value,Path path){}
    public record Leaf(String pointer,Object value){}
    // Empty containers count as leaves; scalar root has empty pointer.
    public static List<Leaf> leaves(Object root,int budget){
        List<Leaf> out=new ArrayList<>();ArrayDeque<Visit> todo=new ArrayDeque<>();todo.push(new Visit(root,null));int seen=0;
        while(!todo.isEmpty()){if(++seen>budget)throw new IllegalArgumentException("node budget");Visit w=todo.pop();Object v=w.value;
            if(v instanceof Map<?,?> m&&!m.isEmpty()){for(var e:object(m).entrySet())todo.push(new Visit(e.getValue(),new Path(w.path,e.getKey())));}
            else if(v instanceof List<?> a&&!a.isEmpty()){for(int i=a.size()-1;i>=0;i--)todo.push(new Visit(a.get(i),new Path(w.path,Integer.toString(i))));}
            else{if(v instanceof Map<?,?>)v=new LinkedHashMap<>();else if(v instanceof List<?>)v=new ArrayList<>();else v=scalar(v);out.add(new Leaf(pointer(w.path),v));}
        }return out;
    }
    private record Pair(Object a,Object b,Path path){}
    public record Change(String operation,String pointer,Object value){}
    /** Structural diff, not a minimal edit script. List indices refer to original input.
     * Report only; don't blindly execute removes in ascending order against a mutable list. */
    public static List<Change> diff(Object a,Object b,int budget){
        List<Change> out=new ArrayList<>();ArrayDeque<Pair> todo=new ArrayDeque<>();todo.push(new Pair(a,b,null));int seen=0;
        while(!todo.isEmpty()){if(++seen>budget)throw new IllegalArgumentException("node budget");Pair w=todo.pop();Object x=w.a,y=w.b;
            if(x==ABSENT){out.add(new Change("add",pointer(w.path),merge(ABSENT,y,false,budget)));continue;}
            if(y==ABSENT){out.add(new Change("remove",pointer(w.path),null));continue;}
            if(x instanceof Map&&y instanceof Map){Map<String,Object> xx=object(x),yy=object(y);Set<String> keys=new LinkedHashSet<>(xx.keySet());keys.addAll(yy.keySet());for(String k:keys)todo.push(new Pair(xx.containsKey(k)?xx.get(k):ABSENT,yy.containsKey(k)?yy.get(k):ABSENT,new Path(w.path,k)));}
            else if(x instanceof List<?> xx&&y instanceof List<?> yy){for(int i=Math.max(xx.size(),yy.size())-1;i>=0;i--)todo.push(new Pair(i<xx.size()?xx.get(i):ABSENT,i<yy.size()?yy.get(i):ABSENT,new Path(w.path,Integer.toString(i))));}
            else{boolean equal=x instanceof Number xn&&y instanceof Number yn?number(xn).compareTo(number(yn))==0:!(x instanceof Map||x instanceof List||y instanceof Map||y instanceof List)&&Objects.equals(scalar(x),scalar(y));
                if(!equal)out.add(new Change("replace",pointer(w.path),merge(ABSENT,y,false,budget)));
            }
        }return out;
    }
    private static void check(boolean b){if(!b)throw new AssertionError();}
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Map<String,Object> a=new LinkedHashMap<>(),b=new LinkedHashMap<>();a.put("x",new BigDecimal("0.1"));b.put("x",new BigDecimal("0.2"));a.put("list",new ArrayList<>(List.of(1,2)));b.put("list",List.of(3));a.put("flag",false);b.put("flag",true);a.put("s","a");b.put("s","b");a.put("null",null);b.put("new",4);
        Map<?,?> r=(Map<?,?>)merge(a,b,true,100);check(r.get("x").equals(new BigDecimal("0.3")));check(r.get("list").equals(List.of(new BigDecimal("1"),new BigDecimal("2"),new BigDecimal("3"))));check(r.get("flag").equals(true)&&r.get("s").equals("ab")&&r.containsKey("null"));check(((List<?>)a.get("list")).size()==2);
        check(merge(Map.of("x",1),List.of(2),true,100) instanceof List);check(((Map<?,?>)merge(a,b,false,100)).get("x").equals(new BigDecimal("0.2")));
        Object deep="leaf";for(int i=0;i<12000;i++)deep=Map.of("x",deep);Object cloned=merge(deep,Map.of(),false,13000);List<Leaf> ls=leaves(cloned,13000);check(ls.size()==1&&ls.get(0).pointer.length()==24000&&ls.get(0).value.equals("leaf"));check(diff(deep,cloned,13000).isEmpty());
        var changes=diff(Map.of("a/b",1,"gone",2),Map.of("a/b",3,"new",true),100);check(changes.size()==3&&changes.stream().anyMatch(c->c.pointer.equals("/a~1b")&&c.operation.equals("replace")));
        List<Object> cycle=new ArrayList<>();cycle.add(cycle);try{merge(cycle,List.of(),false,20);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
        System.out.println("JsonOperations: rich/simple merge, no input mutation, escaped paths, structural diff, 12000-depth traversal and cycle-budget tests passed");
    }
}
